INSERT INTO doctor_schedule_slot (doctor_id, schedule_date, session_type, session_name, start_time, end_time, average_consultation_minutes, total_capacity, remaining_capacity, next_queue_number, status, version) VALUES
(#{slot.doctorId}, #{slot.scheduleDate}, #{slot.sessionType}, #{slot.sessionName}, #{slot.startTime}, #{slot.endTime}, #{slot.averageConsultationMinutes}, #{slot.totalCapacity}, #{slot.remainingCapacity}, #{slot.nextQueueNumber}, #{slot.status}, #{slot.version})
mapper.select: SELECT slot.id, slot.doctor_id, doc.name AS doctor_name, dept.name AS department_name, slot.schedule_date, slot.session_type, slot.session_name, slot.start_time, slot.end_time, slot.average_consultation_minutes, slot.total_capacity, slot.total_capacity - slot.remaining_capacity AS booked_capacity, slot.remaining_capacity, slot.status FROM doctor_schedule_slot slot INNER JOIN doctor doc ON doc.id = slot.doctor_id INNER JOIN department dept ON dept.id = doc.department_id WHERE slot.schedule_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND slot.doctor_id = #{doctorId} ORDER BY slot.schedule_date ASC, slot.start_time ASC, doc.sort_order ASC, doc.id ASC

SELECT id, doctor_id, schedule_date, session_type, session_name, start_time, end_time, average_consultation_minutes, total_capacity, remaining_capacity, next_queue_number, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM doctor_schedule_slot WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, doctor_id, schedule_date, session_type, session_name, start_time, end_time, average_consultation_minutes, total_capacity, remaining_capacity, next_queue_number, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM doctor_schedule_slot WHERE status = 'OPEN' AND schedule_date >= CURRENT_DATE
mapper.update: UPDATE doctor_schedule_slot SET remaining_capacity = remaining_capacity - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OPEN' AND remaining_capacity > 0
UPDATE doctor_schedule_slot SET remaining_capacity = remaining_capacity + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND remaining_capacity < total_capacity
UPDATE doctor_schedule_slot SET remaining_capacity = #{capacity} - (total_capacity - remaining_capacity), total_capacity = #{capacity}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
